title: Workload
description: Represents a containerized workload submitted to an orchestration platform such as Kubernetes, Nomad, ECS, or Docker Swarm. Captures the desired state of one or more replicas of a containerized application along with scheduling, resource, and lifecycle constraints.

name.description: Unique name of the workload within its namespace or scope.

namespace.description: Logical grouping the workload belongs to (Kubernetes namespace, Nomad namespace, ECS cluster).

kind.description: Kind of workload controller managing the pods or tasks.

replicas.description: Desired number of replicas of the workload.

image.description: Container image reference, including registry and tag or digest.

env.description: Environment variables injected into the workload's containers.

resources.description: Compute resource requests and limits for the workload's containers.

ports.description: Network ports exposed by the workload.

scheduling.description: Constraints that influence where the workload runs.

node_selector.description: Labels a node must have for this workload to be scheduled there.

autoscaling.description: Horizontal autoscaling policy for the workload.

status.description: Observed lifecycle status of the workload.
